formula: Where is …? → It is in / on / under …
summary.note: In: ở trong; on: trên bề mặt; under: ở dưới. Tìm manh mối vị trí trước khi chọn.
“In” means inside; “on” means on a surface; “under” means below. “Where” asks about place.
summary.example: The toy is resting on top of the slide. It is on the slide.
